Name: Female Alex - Genderbend with Seasonal Outfit
Author: Azuyorou
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Changes the portraits and sprites of Alex into a female version with Seasonal Outfits

[size=4][font=Arial][b]Requirements[/b][/font][/size]
SMAPI, Content Patcher

[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]
1. Install SMAPI and Content Patcher
2. Extract the folder [i]"[CP] Female Alex - Genderbend with Seasonal Outfit"[/i] into the Mods folder

[b][size=4]Program Used[/size][/b]
Aseprite, Microsoft Visual Code
